title: Special Summer Sale
summary: Do low asset prices represent an attractive entry point? We are in the middle of the dog days of summer. As there is very little going on in the tanker markets, we thought it may make sense to reflect on the state of the newbuilding and S&P market and see if there are any good deals to be had.
